sn55.25:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.25:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sarakāni sakko kālakato hoti.
sn55.25:1.5: tatra sudaṃ sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
sn55.25:1.8: yatra hi nāma sarakāni sakko kālakato.
sn55.25:1.12: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.25:2.4: tatra sudaṃ bhante, sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
sn55.25:2.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
sn55.25:2.7: yatra hi nāma sarakāni sakko kālakato.
sn55.25:3.1: yo so mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya.
sn55.25:3.2: yaṃ hi taṃ mahānāma, sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
sn55.25:3.3: “dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato”ti. sarakāniṃ sakkaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn55.25:3.4: sarakāni mahānāma, sakko dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya.
sn55.25:4.1: idha, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantigato hoti abhippasanno:
sn55.25:4.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.25:4.5: anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti. hāsupañño javanapañño vimuttiyā ca samannāgato.
sn55.25:4.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
sn55.25:4.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā, parimutto tiracchānayoniyā, parimutto pettivisayā, parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.25:5.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantigato hoti abhippasanno:
sn55.25:5.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.25:5.5: hāsupañño javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.25:5.6: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarā parinibbāyī hoti. upahacca parinibbāyī hoti, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
sn55.25:5.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā …pe… parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.25:6.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantigato hoti abhippasanno:
sn55.25:6.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.25:6.5: na hāsupañño na javanapañño, na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.25:6.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
sn55.25:6.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā …pe… parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.25:7.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantigato hoti abhippasanno:
sn55.25:7.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.25:7.5: na hāsupañño na javanapañño, na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.25:7.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti.
sn55.25:7.7: ayampikho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā …pe… parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.25:8.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo naheva kho buddhe ekantigato hoti abhippasanno,
sn55.25:8.4: na hāsupañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.25:8.7: tathāgatappaveditā cassa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
sn55.25:8.8: ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ, agantā tiracchānayoniṃ, agantā pettivisayaṃ, agantā apāyaduggativinipātaṃ.
sn55.25:9.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe ekantigato hoti abhippasanno.
sn55.25:9.4: na hāsupañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.25:9.8: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ, agantā tiracchānayoniṃ, agantā pettivisayaṃ, agantā apāyaduggati vinipātaṃ.
sn55.25:10.1: seyyathāpi mahānāma, dukkhettaṃ dubbhūmiṃ avihatakhāṇukaṃ, bījāni cassu khaṇḍāni pūtīni vātātapahatāni asārādāni asukhasayitāni, devo ca na sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
sn55.25:10.2: api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyunti?
sn55.25:10.4: evameva kho mahānāma, idha dhammo durakkhāto hoti duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddhappavedito
sn55.25:10.6: tasmiñca dhamme sāvako viharati dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī
sn55.25:11.1: seyyathāpi mahānāma, sukhettaṃ subhūmiṃ suvihatakhāṇukaṃ bījānicassu akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sārādāni sukhasayitāni,
sn55.25:11.3: api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyunti?
sn55.25:11.5: evameva kho mahānāma, idha dhammo svākkhāto hoti suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito.
sn55.25:11.7: tasmiñca dhamme sāvako viharati dhammānudhammapaṭipanno sāmīcipaṭipanno anudhammacārī.
sn55.25:11.10: sarakāni mahānāma sakko maraṇakāle sikkhāya paripūrakārī ahosīti.
